value.rationale: A natural extension of coherent absorption to two distinct sinks on a flux-threaded finite cycle yields a complete, robust placement criterion gcd(N,a)=1 for perfect absorption of all inputs at all fluxes, as well as a sharp parity-dependent pi-flux dark-state switch and explicit injection-site survival weights. Exact site weights matter for targeted injection/absorption and are not supplied by a dimension-only statement. This resolves a scientifically motivated finite geometry rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
